§ 01 · The Program

Real shipments,
real decisions.

From managing a supplier relationship and handling a shipping delay, to reducing logistics costs, building a resilient network, and leading a global supply chain transformation, every scenario drops you into a genuine supply chain situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Fifty-one foundations-focused scenarios and forty-nine strategy-and-risk-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real logistics judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a supply chain or logistics professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across procurement, inventory, warehousing, transportation, and global trade.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound logistics judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

Choose your
scenario.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Logistics Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping supply chain and logistics professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in logistics isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, supply chain and logistics roles in English — Mr. Gad Supply Chain & Logistics is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the logistics moments you'll actually face.
